title: Grade 5 French — Thu, Jun 04
description: La maison — Day 4 of 5: Describing your house in sentences
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'J'habite dans une grande maison' mean?
options: I live in a big house
questions.explanation: 'J'habite dans une grande maison.' = I live in a big house. 'Habiter' = to live.

questions.question: Translate: 'There are three bedrooms.'
questions.explanation: 'Il y a trois chambres.' 'Il y a' = there is / there are.

questions.question: What does 'Ma chambre est au premier étage' mean?
options: My bedroom is on the ground floor
My bedroom is on the first floor
My bedroom is in the garden
questions.explanation: 'Au premier étage' = on the first floor. 'L'étage' = the floor/storey.

questions.question: What does 'le rez-de-chaussée' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le rez-de-chaussée' = the ground floor (the level on the street).

questions.question: Translate: 'The kitchen is on the ground floor.'
options: La cuisine est au premier étage.
La cuisine est dans le jardin.
questions.explanation: 'La cuisine est au rez-de-chaussée.' = The kitchen is on the ground floor.

questions.question: What does 'Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télévision' mean?
options: In the living room, there is a sofa and a television
In the kitchen, there is a fridge
In the bedroom, there is a bed
questions.explanation: 'Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télévision.' = In the living room, there is a sofa and a television.

questions.question: Translate: 'My house has a garden.'
questions.explanation: 'Ma maison a un jardin.' = My house has a garden. 'Avoir' = to have.

questions.question: What does 'Je range ma chambre' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Je range ma chambre.' = I tidy my bedroom. 'Ranger' = to tidy / to put away.

questions.question: Complete: 'Nous mangeons dans la ___.' (dining room)
questions.explanation: 'Nous mangeons dans la salle à manger.' = We eat in the dining room.

questions.question: Translate: 'The bathroom is next to my bedroom.'
options: La salle de bains est à côté de ma chambre.
La salle de bains est dans ma chambre.
La cuisine est à côté de ma chambre.
La salle de bains est sous ma chambre.
questions.explanation: 'La salle de bains est à côté de ma chambre.' = The bathroom is next to my bedroom.

questions.question: What does 'Ma maison a deux étages' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Ma maison a deux étages.' = My house has two floors/storeys.

questions.question: Complete: 'La voiture est dans le ___.' (garage)
questions.explanation: 'La voiture est dans le garage.' = The car is in the garage.

questions.question: Translate: 'I watch TV in the living room.'
options: Je regarde la télé dans le salon.
Je regarde la télé dans la cuisine.
questions.explanation: 'Je regarde la télé dans le salon.' = I watch TV in the living room.

questions.question: What does 'Il y a une belle vue depuis la fenêtre' mean?
options: There is a beautiful view from the window
There is a window in the kitchen
questions.explanation: 'Il y a une belle vue depuis la fenêtre.' = There is a beautiful view from the window.

questions.question: Describe: 'Chez moi, il y a un salon, une cuisine et deux chambres.' What does 'chez moi' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Chez moi' = at my home / at my place. The sentence lists the rooms in the speaker's home.
